method: Substantively read complete original publisher articles and record mechanisms, dates, scope and limitations.

source_evidence.scope: Complete official release: supported language gaps, pull-request presentation, advisory-only behavior, exclusions, access and billing.
main_facts: AI Scan supplements CodeQL coverage and marks findings as advisory.
The feature excludes forks and Dependabot pull requests and cannot block merges.
limitations: No independent precision, recall or reviewer-workload benchmark is supplied.

source_evidence.scope: Complete official release: repository exploration, repair generation, CodeQL validation, iteration, draft pull requests, policy controls, supported alerts and billing.
main_facts: Agentic autofix explores files, proposes a patch and reruns CodeQL.
Successful attempts open draft pull requests and still require broader regression review.
limitations: Closing the original CodeQL alert does not establish regression safety or complete remediation.

source_evidence.scope: Complete product article: Gemini preview, catalog federation, zero-copy access, cross-cloud caching, Iceberg interoperability, scale claims and implementation dependencies.
main_facts: Preview catalog federation can expose configured cross-cloud records through Gemini.
Zero-copy access does not independently validate meaning, permissions or answers.
limitations: Preview functionality and vendor performance statements are not an independent business accuracy study.

source_evidence.scope: Complete case study: curriculum grounding, requirements workshop, prototype, staged teacher research, 1,500-teacher pilot, cited classroom outputs, reported metrics and human grading boundary.
main_facts: Sanna grounds editable outputs in curriculum materials with visible sources.
The case describes a staged 1,500-teacher pilot across seven countries.
limitations: Adoption and quality metrics are vendor/customer reported, not independent learning-outcome evidence.

source_evidence.scope: Complete thought-leadership article: scope, identity, runtime bounds, observability, proof limits, automated reasoning assumptions, human judgment and progressive autonomy.
main_facts: Trust in Depth separates scope, identity, runtime bounds, observation and proof.
Formal proof depends on precise rules and assumptions; ambiguous judgment stays human.
limitations: This is a vendor framework, not a comparative control-effectiveness trial.

source_evidence.scope: Complete consulting article: production definitions, narrow scope, objective KPIs, phased rollout, user acceptance testing, early user involvement, evaluation, cost and monitoring.
main_facts: Production guidance starts narrow with definitions, measurable KPIs and user testing.
Monitoring covers performance, cost, drift, infrastructure and fallback behavior.
limitations: Consulting lessons reflect provider experience rather than a controlled cross-company study.
